title: Finished state is absorbing
statement: For every bit string $x$, all $k,j,p\in\mathbb{N}$, running $k$ rounds from the state with fresh cursor $j$, consumed length $p$, and finished phase returns that same state and emits the empty string.
replaced:
For every input $x$, every $k \in \mathbb{N}$, and every seam state in the
finished phase, running $k$ streaming rounds returns the same state and the empty
output: padding after the formula terminator contributes no further output.
